widgets_values:
ANGLE SET - Qwen Image 2.1 + the QMA camera-angles LoRA turn Body Generation's four views into the angles around her (since 22 October; was Qwen Edit 2511).

Lanes (29 October; Plan Angles retired): one shot box per view, 'name | prompt'. Each box's Deal Rows writes '<view> | <prompt>' per shot (001_view-front, 002_view-back, 003_view-profl, 004_view-profr: the VIEWS box order). Join Lists stacks the four lanes, Split Row separates view and prompt, Pick by Name takes each shot's view from CHECK THE MASTER, scaled to 3 MP; one Qwen chain renders them shot by shot. The four views join the shots in one list: saved together and sent to Release Models.
Runs on a Views run (FAMILY Views). On any other family switch this group off: Pick by Name finds no views and stops with an error.
QMA takes ONE reference, the shot's view. Prompt grammar: <qma> direction height distance, relative to that view's camera ('front view' keeps its side). Back diagonals start from the back view.
Model: Qwen 2.1 int8 + cache + kitchen attention, turbo LoRA 1.0 + QMA 1.0; 8 steps, euler / linear_quadratic, CFG 1.
